title: How Abraham's Legacy Drives Modern Geopolitics

teenKit.tldr: More than half the global population traces their fundamental worldview back to a single ancient figure, Abraham. This episode explores how his shared origin story mutated into wildly different geopolitical rules and modern conflicts.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Understanding how ancient theological source codes still quietly dictate modern state borders and laws of war helps you decode the headlines behind global conflicts today.
keyTakeaways: Over half of the world's population operates on spiritual and ethical frameworks stemming from a single ancient ancestral figure.
A shared historical origin story can branch into radically different, and sometimes violently opposed, modern geopolitical behaviors.
Modern political leaders still actively utilize and weaponize ancient theology to signal their credibility and authority to the masses.
